mira: Heads-up: onboarding zenith-13b:int4 on canary is showing intermittent OOMs during mixed short+long conversational traffic. looks linked to high default max_new_tokens + sudden transient batching.

devon: can you share a minimal alloc/log snippet?

mira: pasted clipped logs: 
```
2026-03-18T11:12:09Z runtime: gpu2 alloc failed allocating 1.0GiB
runtime: slab#31 used=3.2GB free=5MB frag_score=0.46
req: model=zenith-13b int4 seq=2048 max_new_tokens=400 batch_window_ms=6
trace: kv_cache::alloc -> slot_compactor -> kernel_alloc -> oom
```

kai: frag_score ~0.45 is high. couple ideas: (1) conservative default max_new_tokens for int4 (e.g., 64-128) during initial canaries, (2) introduce a "gradual_eviction" mode where we partially evict cold KV first instead of forceful compaction, (3) slot_reserve small buffer (8-16MB) so compactor has breathing room.

devon: +1. also try smoothing batch formation: bump batch_window_ms to 25-40ms to avoid large transient agreggation spikes. for throughput tradeoffs we can keep microbatch_count higher but guard p99.

mira: operational proposal for canary patch: 
- default max_new_tokens: 96 for zenith-13b:int4
- batch_window_ms: 30 for canary route
- enable gradual_eviction.enabled=true, cold_kv_fraction=0.6, partial_evict_threshold=0.8
- slot_reserve: 10MB
- concurrency_soft_cap: 0.7 if frag_score > 0.35
I'll run a 2.5h smoke with rps bursts and synthetic workload (mix short=50-token prompts and long=2048-token prompts). will capture alloc_hist, frag_score timeline, evict_ops, host_swap_io.

kai: add a perf harness: 12k short queries + 300 long sessions. measure p50/p95/p99 and host io cost. also track baseline cost-per-token.

devon: quick QA check: lowering max_new_tokens can change generation lengths. add an eval run comparing 300 diverse prompts vs baseline and fail canary if avg generation truncation increases >1.5% or effect size > 0.05.

infra-bot: canary deploy scheduled: canary/zenith-13b-int4 -> 1725604800. Alert: host_swap_io > 110MB/s for 5m -> auto-rollback.

mira: starting canary now, uploading config diff. i'll post summary with metrics and any diffs in generations.

kai: if compactor still stalls, we can instrument slot_compactor call sites and add heap-tag traces to identify large contiguous allocations.
devon: we'll also watch for cost uplift from slow eviction to host; if too expensive we can switch to a tighter partial_evict_threshold or reduce spill_rate. record per-request fallback counts.

mira: noted. kicking off load in ~7m. will update with final summary + logs. :eyes:
